testsuite.name: gspa.integration.workflow.LearnedWorkflowSpec

testcase.name: partial learned coverage remains reportable when no candidate is projected
the learned stage runs last over the raw claims, replaces the heuristic score, keeps the weak candidate and records the model hash
a GO term the taxon constraints forbid is not reintroduced by the learned stage, even when it replaces evidence combination
with the cohort off the same model scores the same candidate differently: the context is a real input
a requested learned stage without a model fails explicitly and leaves a readable ledger, never a silent heuristic run
the production route refuses a mechanism-test artifact and a missing file
inconsistent learned options are rejected [options: [learnedModelFile:null, learnedStage:true], #2]
explicit typed context is strict, and a key supplied both there and by cohort inference is an error [text: {"neigbourhood": {}}, fragment: not valid, #0]

explicit typed context is strict, and a key supplied both there and by cohort inference is an error [text: {"neighborhood": {"p3|EC|EC:2.2.2.2": {"supportMax": -1.0, "nSupporting": 1, "conflictMax": 0.0}}}, fragment: non-finite or negative, #1]

explicit typed context is strict, and a key supplied both there and by cohort inference is an error [text: {"cohort": {"p3|EC|EC:2.2.2.2": {"weighted": {"supportFraction": 1.5}}}}, fragment: supportFraction must be finite and in [0,1], #2]

explicit typed context is strict, and a key supplied both there and by cohort inference is an error [text: {"cohort": {"p3|EC|EC:2.2.2.2": {"nGenomes": 0}}}, fragment: supplied both by the explicit context file, #3]
explicit neighbourhood context reaches the features next to the cohort block
feature export needs no model, writes rows from the same extractor and never a label
a failing run leaves no stale export and no stale reports
direct EC context works without any GO claim, EC-GO mapping or pathway file
